theorem norm_integral_hIntG_le {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N} (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {φ : ℝ → ℂ} {Kv θv : ℝ} (hθv : 0 < θv) (hKv : 0 ≤ Kv)
    (hv : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖mellin φ (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)‖ ≤ Kv * Real.exp (-(θv * |y|)))
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    ‖∫ y : ℝ, hIntG χ φ x (((-1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + y * I)‖ ≤ x ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ) * VgL (DN N) Kv θv :=

note: Lean proves the identity only for smoothings with Mellin transform holomorphic at 0 and exponentially decaying, as a limit of rectangle zero sums with no R; the error term is bounded via Landau's lemma with much larger constants. The book's R misses η(0)log x for even χ when η(0) ≠ 0, a case Lean excludes.
